audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly claimed Talon has no way to close range without a wall to vault off.
audit.why: Riot text for Noxian Diplomacy: 'If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them.' It is a 575-range gap-close on an 8-second rank-1 cooldown, entirely independent of terrain. Advice built on 'he needs a wall' gets a player killed by the leap.
audit.corrected: You win every stage (packet chart is LeBlanc 7/7) on range, not on his immobility: your Q is 700 and your E 925 against his 575 leap and 650 Rake.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose named levels with no cooldown to key off — packet defect flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: Rake 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Noxian Diplomacy 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Shadow Assault 100/80/60 are the timers that make the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Step up when Rake is spent (9s at rank 1). His level 6 is a 100-second ultimate — your kill window is the rest of that minute and a half.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated/outdated mechanics on the page: 'Cutthroat' as a Talon ability, and a 'fed W-execute'.
audit.why: Talon's E is Assassin's Path, a 725-range terrain vault with a 0-second ability cooldown that instead puts the used terrain on a long cooldown — Cutthroat has not been in the kit since his rework. And Rake (W) is a returning volley with a slow, not an execute; the heavy damage-over-time is Blade's End (P) at three Wound stacks. Also unmentioned anywhere: Noxian Diplomacy refunds health and cooldown when it kills, which is exactly why an even-HP duel favours him.
audit.corrected: Name Assassin's Path, note that a vaulted wall goes on cooldown so he cannot repeat the same entry, attribute the bleed to Blade's End at 3 stacks, and warn about the Q kill-refund in the duel line.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Rake 9 to 7, Noxian Diplomacy 8, Shadow Assault 100 at rank 1.

edits.after: - Rake: 9s at rank 1, 7s at rank 5 — the returning blades are most of his lane damage, so stand off the return line. - Noxian Diplomacy: 8s, and it leaps from 575 if you are outside melee. - Shadow Assault: 100s at rank 1, and that gap is your window.

edits.after: Levels 1-2 you outrange and outpoke him cleanly — his Q leaps only from 575 and Rake alone doesn't threaten your HP. Keep him off CS with Sigil poke at 700 and force him to walk into your chain to do anything.

edits.after: Levels 3-6 your full combo still kills him first even through his wall-vault all-in, and Mimic-Chain finishes from range before Shadow Assault adds up. Step up whenever Rake is spent — 9s at rank 1 — and never stand inside 575, where Noxian Diplomacy crits instead of leaping. He'll abandon lane for roams, so ward river.

notes: Fabricated ability killed: 'Cutthroat' appeared in spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1] and is not in Talon's kit — his E is Assassin's Path, a 725-range terrain vault (0s ability cooldown, but the vaulted terrain itself goes on a long cooldown, so he cannot repeat the same entry). Second factual error: spikes[3].text called his damage a 'fed W-execute'; Rake is a returning volley with a slow, and the heavy damage-over-time is Blade's End (P) at three Wound stacks. Third and most load-bearing: four fields claimed Talon cannot close without a wall, but Noxian Diplomacy leaps at any target outside melee range from 575 on an 8-second rank-1 cooldown. Also newly on the page: the Q refunds health and cooldown on a kill, which is the real reason an even-HP duel is his.
